podcast.body: Taylor Swift took Album of the Year for the first time in 2010 with this album, at the young age of 20, marking her as a "youthful Grammy juggernaut" and a prescient bet for the Recording Academy. "Taylor Swift, who was only 20 when she took album of the year for the first time in 2010 with Fearless."

podcast.body: Taylor Swift's sophomore album, released in 2008, featured "numerous heartbreak lyrics" inspired by her relationship with Joe Jonas, the lead singer of The Jonas Brothers. This included the hit song "Forever & Always," continuing her trend of drawing from personal experiences. "Joe Jonas, lead singer for the boy band The Jonas Brothers, was the inspiration for numerous heartbreak lyrics on Swift's sophomore album Fearless, including the hit Forever and Always."
